'''Quasiwood''' was a type of material, with a [[Wood/Legends|wood]]-grain pattern, that furniture was constructed from. As of [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], a table at the [[Spaceman's Rest]] on [[Rafa IV]] was made from dark, heavy quasiwood.<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>
